diagnosis: Customer's 4 GB export job EXP-40128 has been running for nine hours, well beyond the expected one-hour completion time for jobs under 10 GB. Per kb-0005, this job has stalled and must be cancelled and resubmitted.
reply: Export jobs under 10 GB typically finish within an hour. A job that has been running for more than six hours has stalled and will not complete on its own. Please cancel job EXP-40128 and resubmit the export request. If the resubmitted job also stalls, let us know and we can investigate further.
